name: Bent Over Dumbbell Row
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing your torso. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
2. Hip Hinge: Push your hips back and lean your torso forward to about a 45-degree angle. Keep your back flat and core engaged.
3. Rowing Movement: Pull the dumbbells toward your ribcage by driving your elbows straight back, keeping them close to your body.
4. Squeeze and Hold: At the top of the movement, squeeze your shoulder blades together for a brief pause.
5. Controlled Lowering: Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, maintaining form and control.
6. Repeat: Perform 8–12 repetitions per set.
